text: Looking for screen time you can actually feel good about? Meet Oomba Academy.
Short learning games kids genuinely want to play: geography, would-you-rather, chess, and a whole city to explore.
And when they're ready, they become the makers. Your child describes a game in their own words, and the Builder makes it, then plays it to check that it works.
Safety is built in: a made-up name, no email, no age.
Friends join only with a code, and games stay private until your child chooses to share.
Oomba Academy. Free to play, no ads, at oomba.ai.
